info.title: Generation API
info.description: Compatibility baseline for existing customer generation and browser projection routes. Contracts do not guarantee live ordering or elastic capacity. Structural JSON Schema constraints complement runtime checks for exact identity/link resolution, monetary sums, uniqueness by identifier and qualification.

servers.description: Customer API origin. Browser session routes use the application same-origin transport.

tags.name: Customer generation
tags.description: orders:write workspace key; responses omit browser billing.

tags.name: Browser generation
tags.description: Existing session projection; mutations need approved Origin and matching XSRF. Authorization headers are refused.

get.description: Discovery does not establish account permission, available capacity or ordering eligibility.

post.summary: Create a catalogue or immutable-model quote
post.description: A quote expires after 24 hours. Dataset permission, inputs, source availability, pricing and daily limits are checked. Pinned models additionally undergo metadata, architecture, context and sizing checks. A quote does not reserve credit, procure capacity or launch work.

201.description: Created quote; review price, limits and expiry.

400.description: invalid_request, invalid_quote, unknown_offer, unknown_env, env_not_generatable, thinking_unavailable or greedy_unavailable

422.description: model_private, model_not_found, model_unsupported, architecture_unsupported, context_too_long, model_too_large or exceeds_generation_deadline

429.description: rate_limited: daily quote or model lookup admission limit

get.description: Newest 100 across both order modes; created_at descending then id descending. No cursor exists.

post.summary: Confirm one reviewed quote and reserve its price
post.description: Confirmation can reserve or spend credits and enqueue work. Permission and dispatch availability are rechecked before replay or placement. Preserve the original quote and key after ambiguous outcomes; inspect owned state before retrying.

200.description: Existing owned order for the same quote and key.

402.description: insufficient_balance includes available balance and quote price.

404.description: not_found: quote missing or not owned

409.description: orders_unavailable, idempotency_conflict, quote_used, order_limit or source_exhausted

get.summary: Read owned progress and delivery metadata

post.summary: Request cancellation of an owned order
post.description: Reserved work can release its reservation immediately. Running work can drain and deliver verified output after cancellation is requested. 202 acknowledges acceptance; inspect the returned state. Repeated cancellation is not a generic mutation-retry guarantee.

get.summary: Read an owned delivery or finite byte range
get.description: Resolve identifiers from owned detail. A range request can receive 200 or 206; validate bytes and Content-Range before assembly. This handler emits no ETag. Browser URLs use the same-origin transport; workspace keys use the customer API origin.

200.description: Whole binary file; apply the client byte bound.

workspaceKey.description: Account workspace key with orders:write. Expiry, revocation, account access and ownership remain server checks.

browserSession.name: __Host-reliquary_session
browserSession.description: Existing HTTPS session. No workspace key on browser routes. Local HTTP development uses the unprefixed cookie through its configured transport.

FileName.name: fileName
FileName.description: Flat filename from an owned delivery. Percent-encode the segment; never follow an arbitrary URL.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable key for this account and exact quote. Preserve quote_id and key after ambiguous outcomes. Another quote with the same key returns 409; successful replay returns 200 and new placement 201. No automatic mutation retry.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Browser mutations require the request origin or a configured approved app origin. Sec-Fetch-Site, when present, must be same-origin.

Xsrf.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
Xsrf.description: Must match the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. The existing browser transport supplies it.

Range.name: Range
Range.description: Use a finite bytes=start-end interval for bounded client reads. Clients check safe bounds, ordering and their maximum byte limit. This server also supports whole-file responses and delegates range semantics to storage; it imposes no application-level range-size cap.

GenerationCatalog.description: Public qualified catalogue and ordering gates. Discovery, price or a pilot flag does not prove account access, execution capacity or availability at confirmation.

SamplingInput.description: Omitted fields use the defaults shown. Generation refuses temperature zero.

source.description: Source id belonging to the selected catalogue model.

model.description: Public repository. Runtime validation additionally refuses double-dot segments.

pricing.description: Server pricing terms. Estimates and the reservation ceiling remain separate; new terms may be added.

CreateOrderInput.description: Confirm the reviewed quote. Extra JSON fields are accepted by the current handler but only quote_id is used.

OrderProgress.description: Published observations. Acceptance, audit, passing, settlement and realized payout are distinct outcomes.

price_usd.description: Nonnegative historical order price in USD, to six decimal places. Quotes retain their separate 0.01 USD minimum; runtime validation checks precision.

model.description: Public repository. Runtime validation additionally refuses double-dot segments.

KeyOrder.description: API-key projection omits browser billing. Do not synthesize a finance receipt from its price/refund fields.

BrowserBilling.description: Micro-USD receipt. Runtime validators check held+released=reserved while held, charged+released=reserved and held=0 when settled, and reservation versus order price.

price_usd.description: Existing browser projection accepts order prices of at least 0.01 USD.

balance_usd.description: USD to six decimal places. Runtime validation checks precision and monetary arithmetic.

price_usd.description: USD to six decimal places. Runtime validation checks precision and monetary arithmetic.

ApiError.description: Safe server error. Insufficient-balance errors also contain balance_usd and price_usd. Request references use X-Request-ID, not an error-body field.

url.description: Owned relative download route. Runtime validation binds order id, delivery id and percent-encoded filename.
